description: Erection of a two storey rear extension facing onto Thames Road
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings A-001, A-002(A), A-003, A-004, A-005, A-100, A-101, A-200(B), A-300(B). A-301(B), A-302(B), and Design and Access Statement (Feb 2020) [received 05/02/2020] and Flood Risk Form [received 07/02/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The gate piers shall be removed under the supervision of a specialist contractor, stored in a suitable place and then reconstructed like-for-like.
